Section 01

Executive Summary & Architectural Concept

Spatial hierarchy, retail storytelling, and sensory luxury embodied in architectural form.

The "Liquid Amber & Radiant Gold" Narrative

The VELRA flagship boutique is conceived as an immersive sanctuary of olfactory prestige. Balancing the warmth of liquid amber with polished architectural brushed gold and bookmatched Italian marble, the interior is curated to maximize visual depth, product illumination, and intimate client consultation.

Linear cove lighting and concealed 3000K high-CRI LED ribbons backlight every fragrance flacon, accentuating the natural refraction of luxury perfume extracts and casting golden ambient reflections across high-gloss floor planes.

Spatial Zoning & Circulation Strategy
  • 01. Glazed Storefront Portal: Floor-to-ceiling 12mm low-iron glass offering clear, unobstructed sightlines directly into the central consultation island and hero fragrance walls.
  • 02. Symmetrical Perimeter Bays: Dual 2,400mm modular joinery feature walls providing intuitive self-discovery zones for signature perfume collections.
  • 03. Central Consultation Island: 2,400 × 900mm marble-topped tester bar creating an intimate ceremony for bespoke client scent profiling.
  • 04. Discreet Service & WC Core: Seamlessly integrated flush pivot door (~770mm door clearance) for staff storage and restroom facilities without disrupting retail visual harmony.

Section 04

Key Architectural & Interior Design Features

Detailed breakdown of bespoke joinery modules, architectural surfaces, and luminaire integration.

🚪
Shopfront & Glazed Portal

Floor-to-ceiling 12mm ultra-clear low-iron tempered glass with brushed gold PVD stainless steel structural mullions. 3D illuminated brushed brass brand signage mounted above the glazed portal header.

Clear Span:5,900 mm
Glass Spec:12mm Low-Iron Tempered Float
Frame Finish:PVD Brushed Titanium Gold
🧴
Illuminated Perfume Shelving

Modular 2400 × 900 × 350mm full-height display units featuring geometric 3D relief gold backplates. Concealed 24V 3000K high-CRI LED aluminum channels illuminate floating 10mm tempered glass shelves.

Module Dims:2,400 H × 900 W × 350 D mm
Back Panel:Custom 3D Geometric Gold Relief
Lighting:Concealed 3000K CRI>95 Strip
💎
Central Consultation Island

Custom 2400 × 900 × 950mm consultation bar with bookmatched Calacatta marble countertop, bullnose edge detail, fluted brushed brass pedestal base, and lockable glass-topped fragrance vitrines.

Dimensions:2,400 L × 900 W × 950 H mm
Top Surface:20mm Polished Marble Slab
Storage:Soft-Close Lockable Drawers
💳
POS Cashier & Wrap Desk

2200 × 800 × 1050mm cashier desk with sunken POS equipment tray, concealed cable raceways, illuminated brass brand monogram, and acoustic ivory rear wall panelling.

Dimensions:2,200 L × 800 W × 1,050 H mm
Worktop:Matching Italian Marble
Power MEP:Integrated Floor Drop Raceway
🏛️
Bookmatched Marble Flooring

High-gloss 1200 × 600 mm Italian porcelain marble tiles laid with precise 1.5mm epoxy grout matching the tile tone. Integrated brass expansion transition trims at entry and service threshold.

Tile Format:1,200 × 600 × 10 mm
Surface:Polished Satin Gloss (R9 Slip)
Grout:1.5mm Color-Matched Epoxy
💡
Gypsum Coffer & Lighting

Multi-tiered coffered gypsum ceiling with warm indirect perimeter cove lighting (3000K, 24V LED) and recessed anti-glare gimbal downlights (CRI > 90, 15° & 36° beam angles).

CCT / CRI:3000K Warm White • CRI > 95
Cove Drop:150mm Recessed Gypsum Coffer
Control:DALI / 0-10V Dimmable Zones

Section 08

Joinery & Architectural Fabrication Standards

Strict engineering tolerances, substrate moisture resistance, and hardware specifications.

Substrates & Joinery Carcasses

All built-in cabinetry and wall paneling to be fabricated using E1-grade Moisture-Resistant MDF (MR-MDF) or high-density Birch plywood. Exposed edges to be finished with 2mm matching ABS or solid brass edge-banding.

Density:≥ 750 kg/m³
Emission:E1 Formaldehyde Compliant
Metalwork & PVD Titanium Gold

All gold-tone metal frames, handles, and trims to be 304/316 grade stainless steel with Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) titanium gold coating. Hardness ≥ 2000 HV, resistant to perfume oils, alcohol, and tarnishing.

Coating:PVD Titanium Gold
Corrosion:Grade 304 Stainless Base
Hardware & Concealed Runners

Drawer systems to utilize Blum Movento / Legrabox concealed undermount runners with integrated soft-close Blumotion. Load capacity ≥ 40 kg per drawer. Concealed high-security cam locks keyed alike per zone.

Brand:Blum Movento / Legrabox
Rating:40kg Dynamic Load Soft-Close
